create_random_erasing_augmentation: create a RandomErasing instance with configurable probability, area range, and pixel fill mode for data augmentation
apply_random_erasing_to_tensor: apply the RandomErasing callable to a single image tensor or batch of normalized image tensors
configure_erasing_fill_mode: configure the RandomErasing fill mode to const zeros, rand per-channel normal, or per-pixel normal color
use_cube_mode_batch_erasing: use cube mode in RandomErasing to erase the same rectangular region across all images in a batch
generate_random_pixel_patch: generate a random pixel patch tensor using _get_pixels with per-pixel, rand-color, or zero fill modes
